title: Yankees break silence on AWOL Werster while spring training starts with a rocky start
text:
By Leocciano Callao
Published: 22:34 GMT, February 13, 2025 | Updated: 22:36 GMT, February 13, 2025
The New York Yankees have broken their silence about the absence of pitcher Marcus Stroman by spring training.
This week the title holders from the American League went to Tampa to get in shape the coming season. However, the starting pitcher is nowhere to be found, which means that rumors are protesting in an attempt to be traded.
Manager Aaron Boone spoke with the media on Thursday and spoke in the absence of Strawian and noticed how ‘uncomfortable’ the situation was.
‘I clearly want all our players here clearly. That said, I feel at ease again with where he is physically and mentally, “said Boone.
“He is a proud player who has had a great career. It is of course a bit of an uncomfortable situation. ‘
“Of course I want him here and try to push him to be here,” he went on. ‘But again, you also have to respect that this is something that players can do. There is a mandatory date and he chooses that now. ‘
“Of course I want all our players here clearly. Having said that, I am again comfortable with where he is physically and mentally.”
Aaron Boone was asked if it is “disappointing” for him that Marcus Stroman is not at the Yankees in the camp: pic.twitter.com/nlmghoc2u6
– Yankees -Videos (@snyyankees) February 13, 2025
Yankees -Werker Marcus Stroman did not show the first days of their spring training
On Tuesday, Stroman reported to Steinbrenner Field for his physical after an late season in which the Yankees tried and did not fail to exchange him.
Since then he has not participated in the first two days of training courses for pitchers and hitters.
According to the collective rule for negotiating agreement, the mandatory report date is 22 February. A source close to Storman told the New York Post that he intends to report before the first full squad training on Monday.
Boone also admitted that he was in contact with the 33-year-old and to be aware of his absence before he arrived in the camp.
“I had an idea when we spoke. I knew he might have been out for the first few days, “said Boone. ‘But nothing changed with what I said to you about what I feel where he is mentally (s) physical. I certainly understand what it all looks like with the sound around it this winter. ‘
‘The reality is that this is something that is under SMEs, you know boys have this and you see it periodically in time. But I definitely understand the look around it and the story around it. ‘
“I knew he might have been outside for the first few days, but nothing changed with what I said to you about how I feel where he is mentally, physical”
Aaron Boone says that Marcus Stroman is gone from Yankees Camp: pic.twitter.com/bah96totf1
– Yankees -Videos (@snyyankees) February 13, 2025
“I have heard wonderful things about him as a teammate. Boys in this clubhouse have only spoken about him glowing. I am really enthusiastic to meet him.”
Max Fried was asked that Marcus Stroman was gone from the Yankees: pic.twitter.com/d1uuvzuxzu
– Yankees -Videos (@snyyankees) February 13, 2025
“I even had communication with him last night that he is ready to go mental and physical and hopefully to be here in the coming days,” he went on.
Straw man is expected to be the strange man from the rotation of Yankees, with five others fighting for places. Gerrit Cole, Max Fried, Carlos Rodon, Luis Gil and Clarke Schmidt, if healthy, would form the rotation.
Despite the circumstances, teammates still speak strongly about the straw man in the dressing room.
“I heard wonderful things about him as a teammate,” Fried said. ” Boys in this clubhouse have only spoken about him.
Stroman spent his first six seasons with the Toronto Blue Jays and spent two -year Stints with the Mets and Cubs before landing in the Bronx.
